Portrait setting: Stone steps leading up to a Shinto shrine on a summer festival night, seen from below. Behind the character, who stands partway up, worn granite steps climb between rows of glowing red-and-white paper lanterns to a vermilion torii gate at the top, with dark cedar trees framing the climb against a deep blue night sky. The festival's food stalls stand out of frame at the foot of the steps. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.

Portrait lighting — Key: The warm glow of the paper lanterns strung beside the steps, from one side and slightly above. Fill: Warm light rising from the food stalls at the foot of the steps. Bounce: Soft amber light off the worn stone steps. Practical: The paper lanterns and small floodlights at the base of the torii gate.
